newsitem.title: INDONESIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Indorama rated a "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Indorama rated a "buy".

text.p: Goldman Sachs Asia has initiated coverage of one of Indonesia's largest polyester and blended yarn producers, PT Indorama Synthetics, with a buy rating.
Goldman said in its latest research report that Indorama shares were currently traded at a multiple of 9.9 times 1996 forecast earnings, 7.6 times for 1997 and 6.8 times for 1998.
"These are low multiples for trough or low cycle earnings, exactly when one would expect a cyclical stock to trade at a high multiple," it said.
Goldman said other regional and global polyester companies were trading at multiples 30 to 50 percent higher on average.
It forecast Indorama's fully-diluted earnings per share growth at 30 percent in 1997 and 12 percent in 1998.
It said the firm had an excellent track record with superior operating rates and financial returns.
